mapper.select: SELECT book_id, title, author, cover_image, created_at FROM books WHERE title = #{title} AND author = #{author} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO books (title, author, cover_image, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{coverImage}, NOW())
INSERT INTO user_books (user_id, book_id, registered_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bookId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.book_id, b.title, b.author, b.cover_image FROM books b JOIN user_books ub ON b.book_id = ub.book_id WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ub.registered_at DESC
